open: The stage waits!
Evening, light, music: everything sparkles {place_in} today!
{name} and {fr} step backstage: the lights sparkle {place_in}, and {npc} is already warming up at the barre.
The show is soon!
Tomorrow is {event}: {npc} twirls with joy!
Tomorrow is {event}! {npc} twirls round the hall in a cloud-soft tutu, and {crowd} are already taking their seats.
Tap-tap-tap!
Pointe shoes tap the floor: tap-tap-tap! It is {npc}.
Can you hear "tap-tap-tap"? It is {npc} rehearsing {place_in}, and {name} and {fr} hurry to watch.
fact: Sleeps on one leg.
Did you know? A flamingo often sleeps on one leg!
Did you know? A flamingo often sleeps standing on one leg: it keeps the legs warm and lets them rest in turns. A real ballet pose!
A toe like a rock.
The toe of a pointe shoe is hard: it is glued from layers of cloth.
Do you know what pointe shoes are made of? The toe is glued from layers of cloth, so a ballerina can stand on the tips of her toes!
French words.
Ballet words are French: "plié" means "bent".
Almost all ballet words are French. "Plié" means "bent", and "jeté" means "thrown": a leap like a throw!
The Nutcracker.
The Nutcracker was first shown in St Petersburg in 1892.
Did you know? The ballet The Nutcracker, with music by Tchaikovsky, was first shown in St Petersburg in 1892, and people still dance it today!
fun: Boom! Oops!
{rival} tries a pirouette and spins like a top!
{rival} tries a pirouette, but spins like a top and ends up inside the curtain. Oops!
Atishoo!
The dusty curtain tickles a nose: atishoo! Everyone laughs.
The dusty curtain makes {fr} sneeze so loudly that the spectators think the orchestra has a new drum.
Hop! A leap!
{name} leapt, and everyone claps!
{name} made such a big leap that {fr} whispers: "That is not ballet, it is flying!"
Ribbons in a knot!
The pointe-shoe ribbons tangled in a knot: what a bow!
The ribbons tangled into a huge bow, and {npc} dances like a birthday present. Everyone roars with laughter!
final: Hooray! Applause!
The hall claps, flowers fly, and {npc} takes a bow!
The curtain falls, the hall stands and claps, and {npc}, {name} and {fr} bow together. {rival} claps loudest of all!
Bravo, dancers!
Everyone dances together, even {rival} twirls with joy!
The music plays, the lights sparkle, and everyone dances together: {npc}, {rival}, {name} and {fr}. What a party!

open: Hush! Music!
Today {place_in} all the instruments sing: la-la-la!
Today {place_in} the violins, trumpets and flutes are tuning up. {event} is soon, and {npc} skips across the notes with joy!
The concert is soon!
{event} is soon, and {npc} already sings do-re-mi!
{event} is soon! {npc} is so excited that "do-re-mi" comes out in every way, and {crowd} are already heading in.
Ding-dong! La!
Someone is tapping the keys: it is {npc} learning a song.
From behind the doors: do-re-mi-fa-sol! It is {npc} learning a new song, and {name} and {fr} run to listen.
fact: Mozart at five!
Mozart started writing music at about five!
Did you know? The composer Mozart began writing music when he was only about five, almost like you!
Two songs, one tune.
Twinkle, Twinkle and the alphabet song have one tune!
Did you know? "Twinkle, Twinkle, Little Star" and the alphabet song share one tune, which came from an old French song.
The wolf is horns!
In Peter and the Wolf, the bird is a flute and the duck is an oboe.
In the tale Peter and the Wolf, every character is an instrument: the bird is a flute, the duck an oboe, the cat a clarinet, and the wolf horns.
88 keys!
A piano has 88 keys and over two hundred strings inside!
Did you know? A piano has 88 keys and more than two hundred strings inside, struck by little hammers.
fun: Pfffff! Oops!
{rival} blows the trumpet, and out comes a funny "pffff"!
{rival} blows the trumpet with all might, but instead of music out comes "pffff", like from a balloon!
Tra-la-la!
{npc} hops across the keys, and a song comes out!
{npc} skips over the piano keys, and a real song comes out, about a cat who is afraid of the drum.
Boom-boom! Bang!
{fr} bangs the drum: boom! Everyone jumps!
{fr} taps the drum softly, but out comes a "boom" for the whole hall. Even {crowd} jump on their chairs!
Ding-ding! La!
{tool} rings a note, and all sing in their own way!
{fr} picks up {tool_acc} and asks: "Let's all sing 'la'!" The choir comes out so united that {npc} giggles.
final: Hooray! A concert!
Everyone sings together, and the hall rings with joy!
The hall roars with applause, and {npc} and {rival} sing a duet while {name} and {fr} conduct. What a concert!
Music, hooray!
{rival} and {npc} play together, and it is a wonder!
{crowd} stand and clap: the last song fills the whole hall! {name}, {fr}, {npc} and {rival} bow.

open: Quiet! Thinking!
Today it is quiet {place_in}: everyone is thinking about a move.
Today it is so quiet {place_in} that you can hear {npc} think. {event} is soon, and all the pieces are set up!
Chess waits!
{event} is soon: the boards shine, the pieces stand in rows.
Tomorrow is {event}! The boards shine, the pieces stand in tidy rows, and {crowd} take out notebooks of puzzles.
Knight's move!
{npc} sets up the pieces and mutters: "Knight's move!"
{name} and {fr} walk {place_to}, and {npc} is already setting up the pieces, muttering: "What a puzzle!"
fact: Chess is 1500 years old.
Chess was invented in India more than a thousand years ago.
Did you know? Chess was born in India about fifteen hundred years ago, and then the game was called "chaturanga".
The rook is a tower.
The rook looks like a tower and moves in straight lines.
Did you know? The rook looks like a castle tower, and it moves only in straight lines, as if on rails.
A pawn becomes a queen!
When a pawn reaches the far edge, it becomes a strong queen!
Did you know? If a little pawn reaches the other side of the board, it turns into almost any piece, for example a queen.
The famous cube!
Ernő Rubik invented the cube and took a month to solve it!
Did you know? The Hungarian Ernő Rubik invented his cube in 1974 and took a whole month to solve it. What a puzzle!
fun: Where is the pawn?
{rival} hides a pawn in his cheek, and it puffs up!
{rival} hides a pawn in his cheek, but the cheek puffs up so funnily that the whole hall sees where the piece went.
Thinking... Phew!
{npc} thinks a minute, then another minute, then has tea.
{npc} thinks about a move, and thinks, and thinks, so long that {fr} has time to drink tea and count all the squares on the board.
The knight goes in an L!
The knight jumps in an L shape: what a dance!
The knight moves in an L shape, and {name} tries it too, but trips over their own feet. Everyone laughs!
The magnifier! Wow!
{tool} magnifies a pawn: now it is as big as an elephant!
Through {tool_acc} the pawn looks huge as an elephant, and {fr} whispers: "What a fighter!"
final: Hooray! A draw!
Nobody lost: {rival} and {npc} laugh together!
The game ends in a draw, which is best of all: {rival} and {npc} roar with laughter, and {crowd} clap.
Hooray, a win!
We found the answer, and everyone claps!
{name} and {fr} find the right move, and the puzzle is solved! {npc} hoots with joy, and {rival} wants to see it.

open: Mmm, yummy!
What a lovely smell {place_in}: vanilla and cinnamon!
What a lovely smell {place_in}! Vanilla, cinnamon and fresh bread: {npc} is baking for the party, and {event} is soon!
The fair is soon!
{event} is soon! The dough rises like a cloud.
Tomorrow is {event}! {npc} kneads dough and whips cream, and {crowd} are already licking their lips in the queue.
Bang! Flour!
Bang! A sack of flour fell, and all is white as winter!
Bang! A sack of flour falls on the floor, and the whole kitchen goes white as in winter. {npc} laughs: "Let's start!"
fact: Yeast is alive!
Yeast eats sugar and makes bubbles, and the dough grows!
Did you know? Yeast is a tiny living fungus: it eats sugar and makes bubbles of gas, and that makes dough rise.
Honey keeps.
Honey hardly ever spoils: it was found in Egyptian tombs!
Did you know? Honey hardly ever spoils: pots of honey about three thousand years old were found in ancient Egyptian tombs.
Popcorn goes pop!
A popcorn kernel bursts when a tiny drop of water boils.
Did you know? Inside a corn kernel there is a tiny drop of water: it heats up, turns to steam, and the kernel bursts with a pop.
Egg white is like foam!
Whisk egg white, and it turns into white foam!
Did you know? If you whisk egg white for long, air bubbles get trapped in it, and it becomes fluffy foam for meringue.
fun: Meow! Cream!
{rival} licks the cream, and the whole nose is white!
{rival} secretly tastes the cream, and now his nose and whiskers are white. "It was not me!" he purrs.
Blub! Blub!
The dough climbed out of the bowl and crawls across the table!
The dough grows and grows, climbs out of the bowl and crawls across the table, and {fr} catches it with a spoon like a cloud.
Ding-ding!
{tool} whisks so fast that the cream flies to the ceiling!
{tool} whisks the cream so fast that it flies to the ceiling, and {name} catches the drops on a tongue.
Oh, salt!
Salt got in the tea instead of sugar: what a taste!
Salt gets in the cup instead of sugar, and the tea comes out so strange that {npc} wrinkles up a nose and laughs.
final: Hooray! Tuck in!
Everyone sits at the table: tea, pies and laughter!
{crowd} sit at a long table, and {rival} shares the cream with everyone for the first time. What a sweet party!
Yum-yum!
So many treats, and there is enough for all!
{npc} takes rosy buns out of the oven, and {rival} purrs so loudly that {crowd} sing along.

open: Beep-beep-beep!
Today the machines hum and the lights blink {place_in}!
Today the lights blink and little motors whirr {place_in}. {event} is soon, and {npc} checks every screw.
The festival is soon!
{event} is soon! {npc} polishes up until shiny.
Tomorrow is {event}! {npc} polishes up until shiny, and {crowd} are already coming to see new wonders of technology.
Ding! Click!
Something clicks under the table: it is {npc} mending an arm!
Someone clicks and clinks under the table. {name} and {fr} peek in: it is {npc} screwing on a new arm!
fact: Robot means work!
The word "robot" comes from the Czech word "robota", which means work.
Did you know? The word "robot" was invented for a play in 1920, and in Czech "robota" means "hard work".
A tough Mars rover!
A Mars rover was meant to work three months, and lasted years!
Did you know? The rover Opportunity was meant to work on Mars for three months, but drove there for almost fourteen years!
The robot knight!
Leonardo da Vinci drew a robot knight long, long ago.
Did you know? More than five hundred years ago, Leonardo da Vinci drew a robot knight whose arms and head moved.
A rover on the Moon!
A rover drove on the Moon, and was steered from Earth.
Did you know? In 1970 Lunokhod drove across the Moon: a robot on wheels steered by people right from Earth.
fun: Meow! A screw!
{rival} chases a screw across the floor like a mouse!
{rival} chases a shiny screw across the floor like a mouse and nearly knocks the robot off its feet.
Atishoo-beep!
{npc} sneezes, and all the lights blink!
{npc} sneezes: "Atishoo-beep!" and all the lights blink, like on a Christmas tree.
The robot dances!
{fr} presses a button, and {npc} starts to dance!
{fr} presses the wrong button by accident, and {npc} suddenly starts to dance right on the table. What a dance!
Zip-zip!
{tool} spins: zip-zip! The nut is tightened.
{fr} picks up {tool_acc}, zip-zip! and tightens every nut in the lab in one minute.
final: Hooray! It works!
The machine hums, the lights blink: all is ready!
Everyone starts the machine together: it hums, blinks and sings! {crowd} clap, and {rival} purrs nearby.
Beep-beep-hooray!
{npc} and {rival} shake hands and paws!
{rival} admits that {npc} is a great inventor, and {name} and {fr} turn in the last screw.

open: Paint, hooray!
Today {place_in} smells of paint and bright ideas!
Today {place_in} smells of paint, and pictures dry on the walls. {event} is soon, and {npc} is already hopping across the palette!
The show is soon!
{event} is soon! {npc} mixes the brightest paints.
Tomorrow is {event}! {npc} mixes the brightest paints, and {crowd} are already peeking in at the windows.
Splat! Paint!
Splat! A rainbow patch appeared on the floor!
Splat! A rainbow patch suddenly appears on the floor, and {npc} giggles: "I did it by accident!"
fact: Hands on the rock!
Ancient people painted hands on rocks, thousands of years ago!
Did you know? People painted even in caves: the walls still hold handprints about forty thousand years old.
Mona Lisa is small.
The Mona Lisa is quite small: under a metre tall!
Did you know? The famous Mona Lisa is not huge at all: it is under a metre tall, yet thousands of people come to see it.
Blue was like gold!
Blue paint was made from stone and cost as much as gold!
Did you know? Long ago bright blue paint was made from the precious stone lapis lazuli, and it cost as much as gold.
Blue plus yellow!
Blue and yellow together make green!
Did you know? If you mix blue and yellow paint you get green, and red and yellow make orange.
fun: Woof! Paws!
{rival} steps in paint and leaves flower-shaped prints!
{rival} steps in blue paint and runs over the paper, leaving a whole trail of paw prints. What a picture!
Oh! Noses!
{fr} sneezes over the paint, and everyone has a yellow nose!
{fr} sneezes loudly over a pot of yellow paint, and everyone gets yellow freckles on their noses.
Whiskers! Whiskers!
{npc} paints whiskers on every picture, even the Moon!
{npc} loves painting so much that whiskers get added to every portrait, even the sun in a landscape. What a laugh!
Boom! The easel!
{tool} wobbles, and all the pictures tilt sideways!
{tool} wobbles like a ship, and all the pictures tilt sideways. "Now it is modern art!" laughs {fr}.
final: Hooray! The show!
All the pictures hang on the walls and shine!
Pictures shine on the walls, and {crowd} stroll round smiling. {rival} leaves the funniest paw prints on the floor.
Paint together!
Everyone takes paints and paints one big picture!
{name}, {fr}, {npc} and {rival} paint a huge picture, and {crowd} add a brushstroke each. A rainbow appears!

open: A castle! Hooray!
Today {place_in} candles flicker, and fairies sew dresses.
Today {place_in} candles flicker, and unicorns comb their manes. {event} is soon, and {npc} sends up golden sparks!
The ball is soon!
{event} is soon! {npc} shines up the scales.
Tomorrow is {event}! {npc} polishes scales until they shine, and {crowd} flutter through the halls hanging garlands.
Knock-knock-knock!
Someone knocks at the castle gate: it is {npc}!
Someone knocks softly at the castle gate: knock-knock! {name} and {fr} open it, and there stands {npc} with a bouquet.
fact: A horn is a tooth!
A unicorn's horn was a narwhal's tusk, and that is a tooth!
Did you know? Long ago, long narwhal tusks were sold as unicorn horns, but really a tusk is a huge tooth of a sea whale.
A mermaid is a manatee?
Sailors once mistook manatees for mermaids.
Did you know? Old sailors sometimes mistook manatees for mermaids: they swim slowly and hold their babies to the chest.
A dragon is a lizard!
On Komodo island live big lizards called dragons!
Did you know? On the Indonesian island of Komodo live huge lizards, Komodo dragons, and people call them dragons too.
Wings of ten metres!
A giant pterosaur had a wingspan of about ten metres.
Did you know? Pterosaurs were not dinosaurs, but they flew above them: the biggest had a wingspan of about ten metres.
fun: Wow! Hats!
{rival} flaps wings, and all the hats fly into the sky!
{rival} spreads huge wings, and all the guests' hats fly off like birds. Everyone catches them and roars with laughter.
Atishoo! Bubbles!
{npc} sneezes, and rainbow bubbles fly out!
{npc} sneezes loudly, and instead of fire, colourful bubbles fly out of the snout, and {fr} catches them in a hat.
Splash! A frog!
{name} waves a hand, and the boot croaks!
{name} waves a hand to call the stars, but a frog in a bow tie appears instead. Ribbit!
Neigh! A rainbow!
The unicorn snorts, and a rainbow appears in the air.
The unicorn snorts, and a tiny rainbow suddenly appears in the air. {fr} tries to slide down it like a slide.
final: Hooray! The ball!
Lanterns glow, music plays, the party has begun!
Lanterns flash over the hall, and {npc}, {rival}, {name} and {fr} start a dance together.
A fairy tale! Hooray!
{npc} and {rival} fly over the castle, and all wave!
{npc} and {rival} soar over the castle and draw rainbow hearts in the sky. Below, {crowd} wave and cheer.
